hooks.text: 用恐惧、宣传、监控和惩罚或舒适繁荣塑造公民，情绪会从忠诚演变到叛乱
hooks.excerpt: Mold your citizens through fear, propaganda, surveillance, punishment or rule as a benevolent leader through comfort and prosperity. While they work for the State, they may grow grateful, afraid, loyal, or quietly rebellious, until dissent becomes revolt.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 削弱敌人后拖回基地，可在监狱中恐吓、洗脑、处决或转化成公民
hooks.excerpt: Weakened foes can be captured and dragged back to your base. Behind prison doors, resistance can be crushed through fear, indoctrination, execution, or conversion, until an enemy becomes a citizen, a warning to would-be rebels, or another tool of the regime.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 远征收集Roguelite Core，分别改造枪械手感、形成套组协同或强化并牺牲士兵
hooks.excerpt: Collect roguelite cores during each expedition to grow stronger, survive longer, and push deeper into enemy territory. Weapon Cores reshape how your guns handle. Combination Cores create synergies between different core sets. Others strengthen the troops fighting beside you, or turn them into sacrificial shields for your survival. Each run becomes a shifting war machine built around you, your squad, and the chaos you unleash together.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
